headline: Small long-period ESE, clean at dawn — a fun little log session.
today: About a foot and a half of ESE at good period with cross-off NW early makes for a rideable, glassy dawn patrol. It'll be small and playful, best on the incoming before the 10:41 high, and the SE turns cross-on into the afternoon. Grab the log and don't oversleep.

daysToWatch.note: Wild card — S swell spikes toward 4ft-plus but dawn is a 24mph cross-on mess. Afternoon flips to NNW-N offshore and cleans up over the leftover size. That's your window if it holds.
Solid morning session: SSE to 2.5ft-plus on a prime angle with N offshore before the S cross-on shows up midday. Shortboard-able. Go early.
Onshore S 15-18mph on a fair angle — expect bumpy and disorganized. Skip unless you're desperate.
